behavior: trusted model registry exposes bounded capability descriptors without provider credentials
Agent and task selections freeze model identity, capabilities and reasoning effort independently
identity, capability or reasoning compatibility changes reject stale work with model_changed
implicit transfer selections follow the replacement Agent while explicit task model selections remain explicit
chat completions, messages and responses encode reasoning and honor protocol continuation declarations
rate limits, timeouts, network failures, unexpected EOF and server failures have stable retry categories
Retry-After and exponential delay are bounded by host policy and the run deadline
attempt, wait, safe error and partial usage records survive worker reconstruction
one client message remains one run across model attempts
failed text and tool-call fragments are discarded before retry
completed tools are not replayed when the following model request fails or resumes
authorization, sources, model and tool compatibility are rechecked at every retry boundary
run and frontend projections expose recovery without hiding previously completed effects
